# PayGlocal Developer Documentation

> API reference, integration guides, and platform docs for PayGlocal — an RBI-licensed payment aggregator accepting international cards, UPI, and alternative payment methods.

PayGlocal covers three products: a payment gateway (PayCollect hosted checkout and PayDirect seamless), a partner merchant onboarding API, and multi-currency foreign-currency collection accounts (MCA). All APIs are REST/JSON over HTTPS.

## Get Started

- [Core Concepts](/get-started/concepts): Platform model — partners, merchants, payment lifecycle, standing instructions, and identifiers
- [Sandbox & Testing](/get-started/sandbox): Test environment URLs, test card numbers, UPI VPAs, 3DS OTPs, and sandbox constraints
- [Choose Your Integration](/get-started/choose-your-path): Decision guide — PayCollect vs PayDirect vs No-Code vs Plugins with PCI scope comparison
- [Glossary](/get-started/glossary): Definitions for platform terms (GPI, GID, MID, KID, SI, MCA, FIRC, etc.)

## Set Up

- [GCC Dashboard](/getting-started/payglocal-dashboards): PayGlocal Control Centre overview — credentials, transactions, settlement
- [Key Management Overview](/set-up/keys/overview): RSA key pair lifecycle for payment API authentication
- [Generate Private Key](/set-up/keys/private-key): Generate and securely store your RSA private key
- [Upload Public Certificate](/set-up/keys/public-certificate): Submit your public key to PayGlocal
- [Request Construction](/set-up/keys/request-construction): How to construct and sign JWS tokens for payment requests
- [Verify Signatures](/set-up/keys/verifying-signatures): RS256 callback signature verification to authenticate PayGlocal responses
- [HTTP Headers Reference](/set-up/keys/headers-reference): All required headers for every API surface (Payments V2, legacy payments, onboarding, MCA)

## Partner Onboarding

- [Onboarding Authentication](/set-up/partner-onboarding/authentication): HMAC-SHA256 auth (x-gl-auth + x-gl-digest) for the Partner Onboarding API
- [Merchant Requirements](/set-up/partner-onboarding/merchant-requirements): Documents and data fields required per entity type (Individual, Company, LLP, etc.)
- [API Flow Overview](/set-up/partner-onboarding/api-flow): End-to-end onboarding API sequence from Create to Verification
- [Partner Events](/set-up/partner-onboarding/events): Webhook events for the merchant onboarding lifecycle
- [iFrame Integration](/set-up/partner-onboarding/iframe-integration): Embed the PayGlocal KYC/KYB verification iFrame in your platform
- [Webhook Configuration](/set-up/partner-onboarding/webhook-configuration): Register your webhook endpoint with PayGlocal
- [RFI Handling](/set-up/partner-onboarding/rfi-handling): Handle Request for Information (RFI) status during merchant review

- [Payments Overview](/payments/overview): PayCollect vs PayDirect capabilities, PCI scope, and supported payment methods

- [Google Pay](/payments/payment-types/google-pay): Google Pay requirements and integration overview
- [PayCollect Overview](/payments/paycollect/overview): Hosted checkout — card data never touches your server (SAQ A PCI scope)
- [PayCollect CodeDrop](/payments/paycollect/codedrop): Embed the PayGlocal hosted checkout in your page with a code drop
- [PayCollect API Quickref](/payments/paycollect/api-quickref): PayCollect API authentication headers and key request fields
- [PayDirect Overview](/payments/paydirect/overview): Seamless checkout — raw card data on your server (PCI Level 1 required)

- [Webhooks Overview](/payments/webhooks/overview): Payment lifecycle webhook events, payload structure, and retry policy

- [Node.js Callback Handler](/payments/webhooks/nodejs-callback): Complete RS256-verified callback handler with signature verification
- [Handle SI Webhook](/payments/webhooks/handle-webhook): Process SI auto-debit lifecycle webhooks
- [No-Code Overview](/payments/no-code/overview): Payment Links, Invoice Links, and Payment Buttons — no integration required
- [Payment Link](/payments/no-code/payment-link): Create and share one-click payment links from the GCC dashboard
- [Invoice Link](/payments/no-code/invoice-link): Send itemized invoices with integrated payment collection
- [Payment Button](/payments/no-code/payment-button): Embed a hosted payment button on your website

## API Reference — Payments V2

- [Authentication](/api-reference/payments-v2/common/authentication): RSA JWS signing for Payments V2 — headers, token construction, and key IDs
- [Get Transaction Status](/api-reference/payments-v2/common/get-transaction-status): Poll payment outcome after any GPI initiation (PayDirect and PayCollect)
- [PayCollect GPI](/api-reference/payments-v2/paycollect/gpi): Hosted checkout one-time payment — POST /gl/v1/payments/initiate/paycollect
- [PayCollect SI On-Demand](/api-reference/payments-v2/paycollect/si-on-demand): Hosted mandate registration for merchant-triggered recurring billing
- [PayCollect SI Auto-Debit](/api-reference/payments-v2/paycollect/si-auto-debit): Hosted mandate registration for scheduled automatic billing
- [PayCollect Auth & Capture](/api-reference/payments-v2/paycollect/auth-capture-authorise): Hosted authorize-only initiation (captureTxn: false)
- [PayDirect GPI](/api-reference/payments-v2/paydirect/gpi): Seamless one-time payment with raw card data — POST /gl/v1/payments/initiate
- [PayDirect SI On-Demand](/api-reference/payments-v2/paydirect/si-on-demand): Seamless mandate registration — merchant-triggered billing with cardData
- [PayDirect SI Auto-Debit](/api-reference/payments-v2/paydirect/si-auto-debit): Seamless mandate registration — scheduled billing with cardData
- [PayDirect Auth & Capture](/api-reference/payments-v2/paydirect/auth-capture-authorise): Seamless authorize-only with raw card data

## API Reference — Payments (Legacy v1)

- [Initiate Payment (PayCollect)](/api-reference/payment/gpi-paycollect): Legacy hosted checkout initiation — POST /gl/v1/payments/initiate/paycollect
- [Get Status](/api-reference/payment/get-status): Legacy payment status — GET /gl/v1/payments/{gid}/status
- [Refund](/api-reference/payment/refund): Full or partial refund for a captured transaction
- [Standalone Capture](/api-reference/payment/standalone-capture): Capture a previously authorized transaction
- [Auth Reversal](/api-reference/payment/standalone-reversal): Release a hold on an authorized-but-not-captured transaction
- [UPI Intent](/api-reference/payment/upi-intent): UPI intent flow initiation and deep-link response

## API Reference — Standing Instructions

- [SI Subsequent Payment](/api-reference/standing-instructions/si-subsequent-payment): Trigger a manual debit on an ONDEMAND mandate — POST /gl/v1/payments/si/sale
- [SI Status](/api-reference/standing-instructions/si-status): Check the current state of a mandate
- [Cancel Standing Instruction](/api-reference/standing-instructions/si-cancellation): Permanently revoke an active mandate

## API Reference — Partner Onboarding

- [Create Onboarding](/api-reference/create-onboarding): Start a merchant onboarding record — returns onboardingId for all subsequent calls
- [Update Business Details](/api-reference/update-business-details): Submit or update merchant business profile, address, and entity information
- [Add Beneficial Owner](/api-reference/add-beneficial-owner): Submit UBOs (individuals holding >10% equity) — replaces the entire list on each call
- [Update Auth Signatory](/api-reference/update-auth-signatory): Submit the authorized signatory who signs agreements on behalf of the merchant
- [Update Bank Details](/api-reference/update-bank-details): Submit the merchant's settlement bank account (IFSC + account number)
- [Upload Documents](/api-reference/upload-documents): Upload a KYC/KYB compliance document (call once per document type)
- [Configure Products](/api-reference/configure-products): Set payment products (GPI, SI, MCA) and fee structure for the merchant
- [Get Business Categories](/api-reference/get-business-categories): Fetch allowed MCC codes and business category list for natureOfBusiness field
- [Get Onboarding Status](/api-reference/get-status): Check merchant verification state, pending documents, and onboarding progress
- [Get Verification Redirect](/api-reference/get-verification-redirect): Generate a time-limited iFrame URL for document and video KYC/KYB verification
- [Payload Templates](/api-reference/payload-templates): Copy-ready request payloads for all payment flows (GPI, SI, Auth/Capture, refund)

## API Reference — MCA

- [Fetch Virtual Accounts](/api-reference/mca/account-fetch): Retrieve assigned virtual account details for an activated MCA merchant
- [Upload MCA Document](/api-reference/mca/document-upload): Upload a compliance document for an MCA account
